description: This file implements functions for message handling and socket communication within the 'cuttlefish::process_sandboxer' namespace, including receiving messages with credentials and sending string messages over sockets.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message received over a socket, including data and optional credentials.

methods.name: Message::RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives a message from a socket, extracting data and credentials.

methods.name: Message::Data
methods.description: Returns the data contained in the message.

methods.name: Message::Credentials
methods.description: Returns the optional credentials associated with the message.

methods.name: SendStringMsg
methods.description: Sends a string message over a socket with specific flags.
